notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
description:
Cast Rite of Harmony by paying {G}{W}.
Activate Saproling Cluster by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Rite of Harmony triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
